headline: Dow Jumps 350 Points; Coca-Cola Shares Gain On Upbeat Earnings
summary: Dow Jones up 350 points, NASDAQ down. Coca-Cola shares rise 6% after better-than-expected earnings. Oil down 2.2% and gold down 1.2%.

headline: Sherwin-Williams Posts Upbeat Q2 Earnings, Joins Itron, Armstrong World And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Tuesday
summary: U.S. stocks mixed, Dow Jones up 300 points. Shares of Sherwin-Williams rose 7.8% after reporting better-than-expected earnings and raising FY26 guidance.

headline: QUICK SPARK: Coca-Cola Stock Hits Record High After Earnings
summary: Coca-Cola stock rose 7% to a new record high after beating earnings and revenue expectations. This contributed to a 350-point gain in the Dow Jones index.

headline: FIFA World Cup Delivers Coca-Cola's Best Quarterly Volume Growth in 17 Years
summary: Coca-Cola (NYSE: KO) stock surges to a new 52-week high after crushing Q2 estimates and raising its full-year 2026 outlook.
